searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he shared native reader shell defect the awtsmoos revealed beneath chitas a wound shared by every torah post reader road; awtsmoos.com must heal the common vessel once, so ordinary chapters and dynamic ranges carry the same load. direct browser and http evidence a private 390px chrome target reached the standard native post shell but no chitas masthead or torah body. the rendered page contained a server template exception before postlogic.js could manifest the post. an ordinary devarim chapter url produced the identical exception. the owner is geelooy/heichelos/post/ awtsmoos.post.html, which invokes initial content.html with $$sd directly. on normal dynamic routes $$sd is not guaranteed to exist in that parent template scope. the server therefore throws referenceerror: $$sd is not defined before the child template can apply its own safe default. repair law rewrite the complete 108 line parent template. preserve its reader shell and imports. before invoking the initial content partial, derive an object with typeof $$sd !== "undefined" && $$sd ? $$sd : {}. pass that safe vessel into $a. do not patch a line in place. verification obligations 1. ordinary devarim chapter http body contains no therewasanawtsmooserrorhere or $$sd is not defined. 2. dynamic chitas http body has the same clean shell. 3. private chrome renders ordinary devarim through realpost. 4. private chrome renders native chitas masthead and canonical hebrew pesukim through the same reader. 5. no new runtime exceptions appear from the repaired template boundary.

title: CompactJS Static-Link Boundary Corruption
excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He CompactJS Static Link Boundary Corruption The Awtsmoos revealed a reader failure beneath every post, where correct parser truth was widened by a later guess; Awtsmoos.com must let a finite import keep its measured shore, so one module cannot consume the next. searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he compactjs static link boundary corruption the awtsmoos revealed a reader failure beneath every post, where correct parser truth was widened by a later guess; awtsmoos.com must let a finite import keep its measured shore, so one module cannot consume the next. direct evidence the private browser failed identically for ordinary devarim and dynamic chitas with referenceerror: tsmoosprompt is not defined. the exact served postlogic.js?compact=true bundle contained const aiify = ...default;tsmoosprompt; and const parsehebrew = ...default;ult;, while checked in source contains valid awtsmoosprompt and aiservicehandler imports. the merkava parser was interrogated against the real scripts/awtsmoos/api/utils.js. its importdeclaration.start/end ranges are exact. the semicolonless aiify import ends at offset 81, immediately before the next newline; the parsehebrew import ends at 181. modulenodetransform.js then discards those exact ends and calls generic findstatementend(source, node.start). on the same real source, that scanner extends the aiify import from 81 to 127, swallowing the complete following awtsmoosprompt import, and extends parsehebrew from 181 to 231, swallowing aiservicehandler. overlapping replacement descriptors then leave corrupt identifier tails in the generated bundle. repair law static esm link declarations already possess authoritative parser boundaries. importdeclaration, exportalldeclaration, and source/list only exportnameddeclaration must use a validated parser node.end. they must never scan forward for the next semicolon. named exports containing an actual declaration may retain the specialized declaration boundary path, and default exports retain their existing expression/declaration logic. if a static module link node lacks a finite end greater than or equal to its start, compactjs should fail explicitly with a boundary error rather than silently consuming neighboring source. verification universe 1. add a focused parser graph fixture with consecutive semicolonless default imports and a semicolon terminated named import. 2. assert the compiled module executes and all imported bindings retain their values. 3. run the complete focused compactjs suite. 4. fetch the real served post reader compact bundle and assert it contains the full awtsmoosprompt and aiservicehandler bindings with no stray tsmoosprompt or ;ult;. 5. re run private chrome ordinary devarim and chitas at 390px. 6. only after ordinary reader boot is clean should chitas specific ui/runtime refinement resume.
